jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager - Boston
jobs.description:
ABOUT 7AI

7AI is the foundational AI security company. Founded in 2024 by Cybereason co-founders Lior Div and Yonatan Striem-Amit, we came out of stealth in February 2025 to take on the non-human work of the SOC. Our platform pairs a federated SIEM with AI agents that detect, investigate, respond, and hunt, plus dedicated threat hunting and threat intelligence, with humans on the loop.

Backed by $166 million in total funding from investors including Index Ventures and Blackstone, we're building the AI foundation for security operations in the agentic era, and we're still early. That's the appeal: you'll join at a pivotal stage where your work shapes what 7AI becomes, alongside security veterans who've built this before. Our culture runs on respect, collaboration, and a shared bar for excellence, all pointed at one goal, delivering real outcomes for the customers who trust us to defend them.




OVERVIEW

Most of the market doesn't yet know that AI can reliably take on core SOC work, and that kind of awareness doesn't spread on its own. It takes programs built to put the right people in the room. As Field Marketing Manager, you'll execute and scale regional demand generation programs that grow pipeline and revenue. You'll turn strategy into on-the-ground programs: executive events, field activations, partner campaigns, and account-based marketing initiatives. You'll work closely with sales, growth, and product marketing to build experiences that engage prospects and move deals forward across key regional accounts.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Execute regional field marketing programs aligned to pipeline and revenue goals

 - Plan and deliver high-impact events, including executive dinners, roundtables, trade shows, and webinars

 - Partner closely with sales teams to engage target accounts and support deal acceleration efforts

 - Develop and execute account-based marketing (ABM) campaigns for high-value prospects

 - Launch integrated, multi-channel campaigns across field, digital, and partner channels

 - Experiment with AI-driven tools and tactics to personalize outreach and improve campaign performance

 - Track and report on campaign performance, pipeline contribution, and ROI

 - Support co-marketing initiatives with partners, customers, and industry communities


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3+ years in field marketing, demand generation, or B2B marketing in the cybersecurity field

 - Experience supporting pipeline generation through events and regional marketing programs

 - Strong collaboration skills and experience working closely with sales teams

 - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, startup environment with high ownership and execution focus

 - Analytical mindset with experience measuring campaign performance and ROI

 - Familiarity with marketing automation and CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce)

 - Comfort experimenting with AI tools in marketing workflows

jobs.title: Business Development Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT 7AI

7AI is the foundational AI security company. Founded in 2024 by Cybereason co-founders Lior Div and Yonatan Striem-Amit, we came out of stealth in February 2025 to take on the non-human work of the SOC. Our platform pairs a federated SIEM with AI agents that detect, investigate, respond, and hunt, plus dedicated threat hunting and threat intelligence, with humans on the loop.

Backed by $166 million in total funding from investors including Index Ventures and Blackstone, we're building the AI foundation for security operations in the agentic era, and we're still early. That's the appeal: you'll join at a pivotal stage where your work shapes what 7AI becomes, alongside security veterans who've built this before. Our culture runs on respect, collaboration, and a shared bar for excellence, all pointed at one goal, delivering real outcomes for the customers who trust us to defend them.




OVERVIEW

7AI is hiring a Business Development Rep to keep the relationships behind a deal warm long after the first conversation. You'll follow up on event leads, re-engage conversations that have gone cold, and generate a steady stream of qualified leads through outreach that's personal, not blasted. You'll also partner closely with account executives, staying engaged in opportunities beyond the first meeting, multi-threading across the buying committee, and making sure the right people are in the room before a deal needs them to be. This is a relationship-building role, not a dial-for-dollars one: success here is about pipeline that shows up and moves, not who gets credit for it.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Activate marketing-qualified leads through personalized, one-to-one outreach.

 - Follow up on event leads and re-engage cold conversations, so account executives can stay focused on active deals.

 - Partner strategically with account executives: stay engaged in opportunities, multi-thread across the buying committee, and identify who else needs to be part of the conversation.

 - Represent 7AI at industry events and build relationships with the security community in person.

 - Nurture relationships over time instead of chasing a single transaction.
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - A track record of ownership: you can point to something you took on and drove to a result, wherever you built it.

 - Strong time management — you know where to focus your energy and for how long.

 - Comfortable operating without a script: this role rewards judgment over volume, and it isn't a high-volume dialing job.

 - A competitive streak that shows up as follow-through, not just talk.

 - AI fluency: you look for ways to work smarter, not harder.

jobs.description:
ABOUT 7AI

7AI is the foundational AI security company. Founded in 2024 by Cybereason co-founders Lior Div and Yonatan Striem-Amit, we came out of stealth in February 2025 to take on the non-human work of the SOC. Our platform pairs a federated SIEM with AI agents that detect, investigate, respond, and hunt, plus dedicated threat hunting and threat intelligence, with humans on the loop.

Backed by $166 million in total funding from investors including Index Ventures and Blackstone, we're building the AI foundation for security operations in the agentic era, and we're still early. That's the appeal: you'll join at a pivotal stage where your work shapes what 7AI becomes, alongside security veterans who've built this before. Our culture runs on respect, collaboration, and a shared bar for excellence, all pointed at one goal, delivering real outcomes for the customers who trust us to defend them.



Overview
7AI is hiring a Director of Sales Engineering to lead our east region Sales Engineering function. You'll be the technical backbone of our sales organization in the region - partnering directly with Account Executives to run discovery, deliver technical demonstrations, design proof-of-concept engagements, and translate complex security and AI concepts into clear business value for CISOs and security leaders.



What You'll Do

 - Own technical win strategy for East region opportunities, from discovery through proof-of-concept to close

 - Design and run POCs/pilots that prove out 7AI's agentic security capabilities in customer environments

 - Serve as the technical voice of the customer, feeding field insights back to Product and Engineering

 - Recruit, hire, and develop a team of Sales Engineers as the East region scales

 - Build repeatable technical sales methodology, demo environments, and POC frameworks for the region

 - Represent 7AI at industry events, customer briefings, and analyst conversations

 - Partner closely with Sales leadership on territory strategy and account planning



What We're Looking For

 - 8+ years in sales engineering or solutions architecture, with a track record of success in cybersecurity, SOC/SIEM, or security operations technology

 - 3+ years of experience leading or building a sales engineering team

 - Deep technical fluency in security operations - detection engineering, threat investigation, SOAR/SIEM platforms, or AI/ML-driven security tooling

 - Proven ability to sell to and influence CISOs, security architects, and SOC leadership

 - Comfortable operating in a fast-moving startup environment, building process where none exists yet

 - Excellent communicator - able to move fluidly between whiteboard technical depth and executive-level business narrative

 - Based in or willing to be based in the Eastern time zone, with regular travel across the region

jobs.description:
ABOUT 7AI

7AI is the foundational AI security company. Founded in 2024 by Cybereason co-founders Lior Div and Yonatan Striem-Amit, we came out of stealth in February 2025 to take on the non-human work of the SOC. Our culture runs on respect, collaboration, and a shared bar for excellence, all pointed at one goal, delivering real outcomes for the customers who trust us to defend them.




OVERVIEW

You'll build and run 7AI's partner ecosystem across the Mid-Atlantic and Great Lakes regions. The job is to turn regional partner relationships into a repeatable source of pipeline and ARR by making 7AI part of how our partners go to market. You'll work side by side with our field sales team and carry a partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue target.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the regional partner revenue target. Build, track, and exceed partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and ARR.

 - Run co-sell motions between 7AI's field sales team and regional partners, including resellers, SIs, MSSPs, technology alliances, and cloud partners, to land new logos and shorten sales cycles.

 - Turn one-off partner deals into repeatable revenue channels through account mapping, joint business planning, and regular pipeline reviews.

 - Work with our executive, marketing, product, and sales teams to build joint value propositions that give partners a clear reason to lead with 7AI.

 - Find the regional opportunities where partners bring 7AI scale, local trust, and faster deployment.

 - Advocate for partners inside 7AI and help build a partner-first sales culture, while representing 7AI's value across the partner ecosystem.
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years in business development or alliances at a high-growth tech startup, with a track record of meeting or exceeding multi-million-dollar co-sell or channel quotas.

 - Established GTM partner relationships across the Mid-Atlantic and Great Lakes that you can put to work from day one.

 - Experience building partnership frameworks that shift business from 1-to-1 selling to a 1-to-many ecosystem model.

 - A strong understanding of ISVs, cloud economics, and partner business models, and how to align partner incentives with 7AI's growth.

 - You're self-directed, comfortable with ambiguity, and move quickly without much supervision.

 - The analytical skills to shape a partnership strategy and the operational discipline to execute it.

 - Honesty, integrity, and sound business judgment.
